in_marathi.name: Balamohan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Powerful as a Child
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balamohan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balamohan is a combination of two words: Bal and Mohan. Bal means power or strength, and Mohan means one who delights or attracts. Thus, Balamohan can be interpreted as 'Powerful as a Child' or 'One who Delights with Power'.
